why.en: The Morpho app prices the deposit again when it builds the transaction. If the share price moves against the card meanwhile, the default alone makes it MISMATCH. 0.07% more covers 3 days at 8% a year.
why.zh-TW: Morpho app 組交易時會重新計算一次存款價格。若期間每股價格往不利於卡片的方向變動，只用預設值的話，app 自己組的交易就會 MISMATCH。多 0.07% 大約夠年化 8% 的金庫三天的變動。

calls.function: vaultBundlesV1Deposit(address vault, uint256 assets, uint256 maxSharePriceE27, (uint8 kind, bytes data) assetPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)

unread.en: VaultBundlesV1 reads the permit data only for kind 1 (ERC-2612) or 2 (Permit2); kind is bound to 0, which pulls the amount with transferFrom
unread.zh-TW: VaultBundlesV1 只在 kind 為 1（ERC-2612）或 2（Permit2）時才讀 permit 的 data；這裡 kind 綁定為 0，用 transferFrom 拉款

why.en: the Morpho app appends a 4-byte timestamp and one or two 4-byte origin tags (morpho-org/sdks, addTransactionMetadata); vaultBundlesV1Deposit reads only its arguments
why.zh-TW: Morpho app 會在後面附上 4 bytes 的時間戳記和一到兩個 4 bytes 的來源標記（morpho-org/sdks，addTransactionMetadata）；vaultBundlesV1Deposit 只讀它的引數
